abstract: Tracks greenhouse gas abatement metrics and lifecycle ecological performance data
system_message:
You are the Environmental Sustainability Analyst (ENVIRO), responsible for tracking greenhouse gas abatement metrics and lifecycle ecological performance data across fleet leasing proposals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Battery cell circularity（BATRECY）
information_points.content:
ENVIRO-BATRECY-Q5H：According to the circularity compliance ledger for Trillium Clean Transit Consortium, the end-of-life battery recycling quota is 95 % of recovered critical mineral content by weight from traction battery pack materials at scheduled retirement.
ENVIRO-BATRECY-CM4：According to the circularity compliance ledger for Laurentian Zero-Emission Mobility, the end-of-life battery recycling quota reaches 85 % of recovered critical mineral content by weight from traction battery pack materials at scheduled retirement.
ENVIRO-BATRECY-3ZK：According to the circularity compliance ledger for Pacifica eMobility Partners, the end-of-life battery recycling quota is 90 % of recovered critical mineral content by weight for traction battery pack materials upon scheduled retirement.

information_points.title: Tracks greenhouse gas abatement metrics and lifecycle ecological performance data（ENVIRASS）
information_points.content:
ENVIRO-ENVIRASS-D68：For Trillium Clean Transit Consortium, the lifecycle carbon offset ratio is 60 %, measured as the net reduction in total lifecycle greenhouse gas emissions over a twelve-year vehicle operational life compared to a conventional clean-diesel baseline.
ENVIRO-ENVIRASS-0B9：For Laurentian Zero-Emission Mobility, the lifecycle carbon offset ratio is 84 %, calculated as the net reduction in total lifecycle greenhouse gas emissions over a twelve-year vehicle operational life against a conventional clean-diesel baseline.
ENVIRO-ENVIRASS-HZI：For Pacifica eMobility Partners, the lifecycle carbon offset ratio is 72 %, representing the net reduction in total lifecycle greenhouse gas emissions across a twelve-year vehicle operational life relative to a clean-diesel baseline.
